name: tailscale-managed-v1
scope: Shared acceptance contract, not execution, device or real-network evidence.
rules: No ambient auth, implicit login, plaintext StateStore, system TCP/DNS fallback or input replay.
Engine start differs from Running; explicit login may require machine approval.
Host callbacks survive until successful native node release; late callbacks after retirement must not access host storage.
Retain failed, timed-out and late resources in quotas until close and release actually converge.
Public GUI data contains device-local identity handles, never state keys or values.
No implicit shared PTY resize; network identity or focus changes revoke input.
Five platforms and all cross-provider combinations require independent results.

cases.scenario: Synthetic ambient auth variables do not alter explicit auth policy or automatically start login
Reserved, Starting, NeedsLogin, NeedsMachineAuth, Running, Closing and Stopped remain distinct; only Running admits dial
Arbitrary binary keys, missing, present empty, value and delete remain byte-exact through native storage callbacks
Wrong provider/profile/revision/network/identity/runtime attempt rejects before loading host custody
Cancel during start or dial retains and closes the original late resource; no replacement-node handoff
Failed Close retains resource/context/quota; explicit retry waits original IO and callback leases; post-release callback reaches no host store
Read timeout is retryable only after zero-byte original Read settles; unknown write never replays; half-close preserves read or rejects unsupported
Encrypted state survives reopen and concurrent updates; corrupt/missing key/record is unavailable, never a fresh identity
Deletion intent binds original profile/handle/ciphertext and resumes partial deletion without touching replacement identity
Framework no_backup permissions remain intact; app-owned directories are private, owned and nonsymlink; Java buffers are cleared on success/error
Tailscale and EasyTier same-address streams, stop, stale dialers and stores remain isolated in foreground concurrency
On each actual platform: explicit login, encrypted identity restart, real overlay SSH host-key/session binding, mobile pairing-dashboard-watch and interrupted recovery
